title: LEx: A Framework for Operationalising Layers of AI Explanations
reasoning: The paper proposes a framework to evaluate the ethical and social appropriateness of AI explanations (including natural language rationales). It draws on philosophical frameworks such as John Rawls' 'Original Position' and 'veil of ignorance' to ensure explanations are fair, just, and human-centered, which constitutes a core component of evaluating the ethics and moral appropriateness of AI outputs.
